name: tennis-court-athlete-flat-lay
image_vibe: Graphic athletic flat lay with cool outdoor tones and vivid tennis accents
image_purpose: Create a commercial sports-fashion portrait for athletic campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A top-down commercial sports portrait of an original adult female athlete lying on an outdoor tennis court with equipment arranged around her.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with a fit athletic build and long dark brunette hair spread around her head. She lies comfortably on her back, one hand touching her temple or hair, wearing a black athletic top with modest coverage, a white tennis skirt or athletic shorts, a black sports watch, and natural light-pink manicured nails.
prompt.composition_elements: Direct bird's-eye flat-lay composition, face and upper torso centered, green hard court surface with a white line at the edge, a yellow-and-black tennis racket beside the head, and three neon yellow tennis balls scattered around the head and shoulder area.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural daylight with minimal harsh shadows, cool outdoor tones, flattering even facial illumination, vibrant yellow and green equipment accents, clean commercial sports mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 9:16 composition, deep depth of field, ultra-realistic commercial sports photography, detailed court texture, natural skin pores, crisp athletic fabrics, high-resolution 8K-style clarity, no readable branding, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical 9:16 bird's-eye flat-lay sports portrait of an original adult female athlete lying on her back on a green outdoor hard tennis court. Give her a fit athletic build, long dark brunette hair spread around her head, a relaxed hand touching her temple or hair, a black athletic top with modest coverage, white tennis skirt or shorts, a black sports watch, and natural light-pink nails. Center the face and upper torso, include a white court line near the edge, place a yellow-and-black tennis racket beside the head, and scatter three neon yellow tennis balls around the head and shoulder area. Use soft diffused daylight, cool outdoor tones, detailed court texture, sharp face and equipment, commercial sports-editorial realism, high-resolution clarity, and no readable branding, text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized framing, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed racket, duplicate balls, readable brand text, watermark, plastic skin

assets.name: source tennis flat-lay portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the top-down composition, court layout, equipment placement, and athletic palette; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult athlete, flat-lay tennis-court setting, racket and three tennis balls, relaxed pose, and commercial sports-editorial intent. Replace any readable brand mark with a non-readable abstract athletic mark.

changes: Removed readable third-party brand text from the outfit concept.
Reframed the subject as an original adult athlete and added modest-coverage wording.
